notes: Eclipse Loop 1.5.1 - creative FX now actually apply, everywhere. This release fixes a long-standing class of bug where the loop-editing effects only touched the sampler preview and never reached the processor's play buffer, so they were inaudible or stale on the main transport and on pad/step/loop-retrigger playback. Now every edit commits to both paths. Fixes: XFADE was completely inaudible (redraw-only) - now applies; NORMALIZE, GAIN, FADE IN/OUT, SHUFFLE and reverse-selection now affect pad/step playback, not just the preview; STUTTER is reworked into a tempo-synced, grid-locked randomized roll (a few smooth 1/div rolls on random bars) that keeps the loop perfectly in sync and never changes its length; every left-click FX menu now actually applies its pick (a dispatch bug made several silently do nothing); PORTAL sensitivity no longer switches PORTAL on when it's off; comping no longer defaults a clip to a silent take. Eclipse Vibe: kit hardening - safer slot publishing on Apple Silicon and no stray ringing voice when you remove or re-engine a drum. Still 4 synths (Prism, Alloy, Dusk, Vibe) + 25 FX bundled, universal (Apple Silicon + Intel), macOS 12+.
